description.value: Liberty Wine Merchants is a Vancouver institution founded in 1986, built around artisan and small-batch wines from independent producers rather than mass-market labels. With five Lower Mainland locations — including Point Grey, Commercial Drive, and Granville Island — it also stocks a wide range of spirits, beer, cider, and sake. A touring cyclist looking to pick up a distinctive bottle for the evening would find the selection well above average for a neighbourhood bottle shop.
